commit.message:
Enable `NODE_COMPILE_CACHE` when running JS compiler tools (#28116)

Set `NODE_COMPILE_CACHE` to `cache.get_path('node_compile_cache')` in
`shared.run_js_tool` when `FROZEN_CACHE` is not set, and route
`building.acorn_optimizer` through `shared.run_js_tool` so
`tools/acorn-optimizer.mjs` also benefits from Node's V8 compile cache.

On a local `emcc -O2 hello_world.o` link (20 runs), this reduces total
link time by ~20 ms (~3.3%, from 602.3 ms to 582.3 ms median; and from
787.8 ms to 768.3 ms when `compiler.mjs` also runs), with
`acorn-optimizer.mjs` itself dropping from 174.4 ms to 161.3 ms (~7.5%).
